cohort: The study included 327 patients undergoing frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles at a single reproductive center, comprising a group who recently recovered from COVID-19 and a control group not infected and unvaccinated.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection after oocyte retrieval had no detrimental effect on subsequent frozen-thawed embryo transfer outcomes, with similar live birth rates and other secondary outcomes between the recovered and control groups.
